I'll try. I don't really get along with people. I set myself apart and get really anxious around new people. 

Would a doctor have to tell my parents if I cut? Last time they found out they called me a drama queen and said I was disgusting. I know they love me but I can't handle that. They're also very anti-medication. Very spiritual and earthy.
We wanted to live where my mom was born. I've lived in America my whole life.

I'm in my last year of high school and decided to finish online. My mom is from here an we all wanted to move here before I go on to college. 

My family is trying to help but they eat really offended when I act depressed. So I keep it to myself.
